scope: Research-only bounded public-artifact admission, semantic job derivation and strict CPU result verification. Not a runnable scheduler/coordinator, durable journal, host integration or performance result.

implementation.feature_gate: block-v2; no new C ABI, runtime switch or network protocol
implementation.semantic_identity: Domain-separated existing Poseidon2 field-hash construction over schema, construction, operation, ordered start, full expected public statement and ordered dependency IDs. Randomized artifact digests stay separate; backend/worker/candidate/attempt fields do not alter semantic reuse identity.
implementation.artifact_identity: Separate domain; kind, exact length and all bytes (little-endian u32 limbs, explicit byte length) are bound. Hash identity alone never authorizes a proof.
implementation.admission: Existing LBV2WL02 wallet header and bounded canonical legacy payload; existing node codec; at most 2 MiB including header. Registry geometry and cap lengths checked before identity work. Only public WalletProof bytes; no witness input.
implementation.statements: Wrap/registered WrapPair/Empty/Merge derive expected statements through existing ordered commitment functions; checked context, construction, range/alignment, depth, count and dense-prefix rules.
implementation.verification: VerifiedWallet requires original CPU wallet verification. VerifiedNode requires pinned registry and exact job-derived expected public statement through Registry::verify. No public constructor can fabricate either verified ticket.
implementation.remaining_boundaries: Proof validity does not establish host eligibility. Attempt fencing, exact frozen input manifests, candidate attachment, availability, durable publication, scheduling and resource/deadline admission are not yet implemented.

initial.reason: Initial admission decoded the entire existing local wallet artifact as payload without removing its required LBV2WL02 header. Corrected to require the existing header and decode only its payload; also removed one unused import. No proof format was changed.

checks: source archive matches all archived current files

structural: Artifact kind/byte/length/zero-padding separation and size bounds.
Registry geometry/cap-shape rejection before expensive identity work.
Semantic reuse across different randomized input artifact identities; order and position remain bound.
Wrong construction, context, child range/level and non-dense prefix rejection.
Native padded depth-six/count-one statement equals independent commitment root; not a recursive depth-six proof.
real_fixture: Verify all eight independent public wallet artifacts on CPU.
Reject stripped/wrong wallet headers, trailing data, changed wallet bytes and wrong chain.
Derive four paired jobs and three merge jobs; compare root to independently pinned expected root.
Verify the preserved opening-enabled root against the derived root job on CPU.
Reject wrong level/job, swapped transaction order, mutated root proof and trailing encoding.

remaining: Bounded local DAG readiness and candidate attachment/sealing/invalidation.
Per-attempt frozen input identities, cancellation/expiry fences and idempotent completion.
Durable journal/artifact store with crash recovery and CPU revalidation before reuse.
CPU worker adapter, aggregate resource/deadline admission and arrival-driven correctness harness.
GPU residency/recomputation performance work; full64, full-type, deadline, security and host integration gates remain open.
